# EvCard

> A bordered block that frames one subject: optional image, title and description, header action, body and footer.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:card` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvCard } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvCard>` or `<ev-card>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/card/EvCard.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<section class="ev-card">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvCard
  title="Pengadaan Server"
  description="Diajukan 12 Mar 2026"
>
  Total nilai kontrak Rp 1.240.000.000 untuk 24 unit.
  <template #footer>
    <EvButton variant="secondary-light" size="small">Batal</EvButton>
    <EvButton size="small">Setujui</EvButton>
  </template>
</EvCard>
```

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Card**, frame `4220:70848` (Card). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Group related information and actions into a self-contained block — summaries, list items, dashboard tiles, or media previews.

### When not to use

- A single line of text or a plain layout container with no grouping purpose. Avoid deeply nesting cards inside cards.

### Do

- Keep one clear subject per card. Use the footer for the card's primary and secondary actions. Use the Image type for media-led content.

### Don't

- Don't overload a card with unrelated actions. Don't put more than two footer buttons. Don't stretch the Small type with long content.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvCard`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<section class="ev-card">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:card` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
